description: This file contains functions for parsing clipboard text, converting text to HTML, and detecting Markdown syntax within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for handling Markdown and plain text, as well as pattern matching for Markdown syntax detection.

methods.name: clipboardTextParser
methods.description: Parses clipboard text into a Slice object, handling Markdown if detected, or converting plain text to HTML.

methods.name: convertTextToHTML
methods.description: Converts plain text into HTML paragraphs with spacing and encoded non-ASCII characters.

methods.name: encodeLine
methods.description: Encodes a line of text, replacing spaces with non-breaking spaces for indentation and inline spacing.

methods.name: isProbablyMarkdown
methods.description: Detects whether a given text string is likely Markdown based on pattern matching and scoring.
